author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
Stephen Miller is Trump’s new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles. Miller has been part of Trump’s inner circle since the 2016 campaign and became a key architect of his immigration agenda.

In this excerpt from FRONTLINE’s "Zero Tolerance," see how Miller rose from campaign aide and speechwriter to one of Trump’s most influential advisors.
title: Before Chief of Staff: Stephen Miller’s Rise in Trump’s World
